messages:
sarah: Heads-up — need a quick cross-team handshake on Project Orion (ACME private onboarding). Customer requires private VPC deployment, KMS/HSM, reserved GPUs, and strict launch SLAs. Can we sync scope and owners now?
chris: +1. Quick Q: model size and expected concurrency? runtime implications differ a lot between 13B and 70B.
anya: infra note — we'll need a quota request lead time and a dedicated pool plan. Also VPC peering + NATs for logging. I can own infra work but need concrete perf targets.
sarah: Thanks. Model is a 70B variant with ~13k token context for threads. Customer expects steady 1k QPS (mixed short prompts + chat), and peak bursts to ~3k. Launch criteria (proposed):
```
SLOs:
  p95_latency_ms: 250
  cold_start_ms: 4000
  availability_pct: 99.95
Canary success: correctness pass + perf within 10% of target
Security: KMS-backed keying, audit logs retained 1y
```
These are aggressive but necessary for their SLA.
mike: Security ack. For KMS/HSM we'll need design doc for key lifecycle + token sanitization. Customer also wants egress restrictions and proof of enclave where possible. I can draft controls — need timeline and whether data plane runs in their VPC or ours.
sarah: Data plane must run in their VPC (private deployment). Control plane can be managed.
jess: Platform: rollout plan suggestion — canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with auto-fallback to hosted model if p95 > 350ms during canary. Need feature flags + rollout automation. I can own rollout automation + playbook.
sam: QA: we'll need sample production traces and a perf harness. Can we get a representative request log and model artifacts (quantized checkpoint or recipe)? ETA for test harness ~2w once artifacts available.
chris: Perf team will build perf matrix. Need answers on quantization (FP16 vs 4-bit) and whether KV caching enabled across requests. Also need to know expected seq length distribution.
anya: Infra asks — reserve 8x H100-class nodes for initial pool (scales up), private subnet config, and cross-account peering. Lead time for procurement/config ~3w after sign-off. Owner: anya.
mike: Security follow-ups: 1) KMS key rotation policy 2) audit log retention + SIEM integration 3) threat model for customer-side VPC. I'll create security checklist and share by EOD Friday.
sarah: Owners recap: chris -> runtime/perf + canary metrics; anya -> infra reservations + networking; mike -> security controls + design; jess -> rollout automation + feature flags; sam -> test harness. Everyone ok?
chris: :thumbsup: I'll add perf goals to the onboarding doc and drop a table. Need model artifact link.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll kick off quota request draft and ping infra procurement.
jess: :thumbsup: I'll stub the canary playbook in the repo and add rollback steps.
sam: Got it — will draft test cases and perf scenarios.
mike: Confirmed. Will add controls and ask for legal wording on audit retention.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Project Orion cross-team kickoff — Thu 10:30am in #meeting-room-2.ics (invite sent)
sarah: Great — agenda for kickoff: 1) confirm SLOs and scope 2) infra lead times and procurement 3) security checklist 4) rollout cadence and test plans 5) immediate blockers. Please bring any doc links or sample logs.
chris: I'll attach a perf sample by tomorrow.
anya: I'll attach infra diagram + tentative timeline.
jess: I'll add canary playbook draft.
sarah: Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding doc with owners and post the kickoff invite in calendar. Action items pinned: chris/perf artifact, anya/quota draft, mike/security checklist, jess/canary stub, sam/test harness.
